ditto.obtainedAt: Wild encounters across Paldea (including outbreaks); also available via picnic eggs from a Ditto parent pair.

hyperTrainingAccess.bottleCap: Tera Raids and Porto Marinada auctions once you are deep into postgame progression
hyperTrainingAccess.goldBottleCap: Accumulators auction listings and rare special rewards

natureAcquisition.how: Keep hunting wild encounters, Tera Raids, and outbreaks until the target nature appears — Synchronize no longer forces wild natures in Scarlet/Violet. Once you have one parent with that nature, picnic eggs from it (with an Everstone) are the reliable route.

speciesDetermination.femaleDeterminesSpecies: The female parent determines the offspring's species.
speciesDetermination.withDitto: With a Ditto pair, the non-Ditto parent determines the offspring's species.

abilityAcquisition.hidden: Catch one with the hidden ability (outbreaks, Tera Raids, or random wild encounters), or apply an Ability Patch to a parent that already has a standard ability.

eggMoveAcquisition.how: Catch or hatch one that already knows the move, or copy it at a picnic with a Mirror Herb.

masudaAcquisition.how: You may already have one — a Japanese Charmander with an English Ditto would count. Otherwise trade for one, or import from a cartridge saved in another language.

eggEfficiencyModifiers.name: Egg Power Sandwich
eggEfficiencyModifiers.effect: Raises how often eggs appear in the picnic basket — Lv. 3 is about 10× egg-find chance; Lv. 2 is the practical everyday target from shop ingredients. · Shortens the steps needed to hatch eggs while active.
eggEfficiencyModifiers.availability: Cook at a picnic. Lv. 2 recipes use common shop ingredients (for example a Great Peanut Butter Sandwich). Lv. 3 needs Herba Mystica from 5★+ Tera Raids.

eggEfficiencyModifiers.name: Flame Body (or Magma Armor / Steam Engine) in party
eggEfficiencyModifiers.effect: Halves the steps needed to hatch eggs while that Pokémon is in your party.
eggEfficiencyModifiers.availability: Any party slot. These abilities do not stack with each other — one holder is enough.

exampleHolders.place: South Province (Areas One, Three–Five) and West Province Area Three
Area Zero and North Province Area Two

eggEfficiencyModifiers.name: Ride Koraidon / Miraidon
eggEfficiencyModifiers.effect: Eggs hatch from steps taken. Cover ground on your ride legendary — that is the fast path.
eggEfficiencyModifiers.availability: Hatch progress stops while climbing, gliding, or flying, so stay on the ground. Keep at least one non-egg Pokémon in the party.

eggMoveAlternative.name: Mirror Herb
eggMoveAlternative.howItWorks: Held during a picnic, it copies egg moves from a partner that already knows them.

moveDescriptions.Dragon Dance: Raises the user's Attack and Speed by one stage each.

abilityDescriptions.Blaze: When this Pokémon's HP is at or below one-third, the power of its Fire-type moves is boosted.
abilityDescriptions.Solar Power: In harsh sunlight, Special Attack rises, but the Pokémon loses some HP at the end of each turn.

hatchMechanicExplainer: Eggs show up in the picnic basket while two compatible Pokémon are in your party picnic. Egg Power sandwiches raise how often eggs appear and also shorten hatch time — Lv. 2 from shop ingredients is the everyday target; Lv. 3 needs Herba Mystica from 5★+ Tera Raids and is roughly 10× the base find rate. A party Pokémon with Flame Body, Magma Armor, or Steam Engine halves remaining hatch cycles (abilities do not stack with each other). Hatch by covering ground on Koraidon or Miraidon — stay on the ground, and keep at least one non-egg Pokémon in the party.
